modules.name: Co-op / Challenge
modules.note: Campaign chapters and Challenge difficulty add their own setup.

steps.text: Board with the numbered side up (no Journey)
Sun and Moon tokens on the first space left of the center path; resources, point and Occupied tokens as the supply
Shuffle the Critters and Constructions; fill every Meadow spot left to right, top row first
Shuffle the River tiles facedown; {n} faceup on the River spaces
4 Season tiles on the right in order winter, spring, summer, autumn - {side}
1 random tile from each lettered Event set + the Faire tile, shuffled, one on each Event spot
Journey Event tile on its space on the far right
Place skunk workers for each section (Events, Meadow, Locations) as your chapter or difficulty says, rolling the die for each spot
steps.note: Skip the Journey space and the middle handshake spot

steps.text: Challenge: the first skunk goes on the "A" Event instead of rolling
Sun and Moon on the furthest left uncovered Meadow path space
Solo: you play both mayors; keep the two hands faceup above their reference cards
3 Hare workers to whoever most recently took a nap; 3 Tortoise workers to the other
Resolve the steps on the Winter season tile
After every action move the Sun or Moon one space; at the end of its path that action is closed
Any time on your turn: discard 2 cards for 1 resource
Each turn take 1 action: place a worker, play a card, or pick a card
